observation: Long cruiser stance, full fenders, stepped saddle, panniers and tall screen are present. Frame intrudes into the tank and seat mounting regions; source interference confirms paired clashes.

findings.defect: Frame and attached body interfaces overlap
findings.evidence: Front/iso: tank neck and saddle support meet through solid material; exact interference also finds swingarm and bridge tongue clashes.
findings.repair: Relieve the chassis at shared tank, seat and swingarm envelopes and open the steering slot to the bridge shoulder.
